reader.notPublished: This story hasn't been published yet.
reader.noChapters: This story has no chapters yet.
reader.mapUnavailable: This chapter's map couldn't be loaded.
reader.sceneHidden: This chapter's map is unavailable or has been deleted, so the chapter is shown without it.
reader.sceneUnavailable: This chapter's map is unavailable or has been deleted.

list.emptyDescription: A story pairs chapters of text and images with scenes on saved maps.
list.deleteDescription: <1>{{title}}</1> will be permanently deleted. The maps it uses are not affected.

create.title: New story
create.description: Give the story a title. It starts as a private draft that only you and admins can see.

details.heading: Story details
details.description: Changes here apply right away, without publishing.
details.visibilityHint: Readers see the published story. A visibility wider than a map the story uses is refused.
details.visibilityBlocked: These maps can't be read by everyone this visibility reaches. Widen their visibility first, or keep the story narrower.

cover.heading: Cover image
cover.hint: Shown on the story's card and above its first chapter. It changes when you save these details.

publish.blockedDescription: Some maps in this story can't be read by everyone the story's visibility reaches. Make them visible to that audience, or narrow the story's visibility in Details.

unavailable.title: Story not available
unavailable.anonymous: It may have been deleted, or you may need to sign in to read it.
unavailable.signedIn: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

editor.forbiddenDescription: Only the story's owner or an admin can edit it.
editor.stale: This draft was changed somewhere else after you opened it. Load the latest version, or save yours over it.
editor.noChapters: This story has no chapters yet. Add one to start.
editor.removeChapterDescription: “{{title}}” and its text will be removed from the draft.
editor.discardDescription: The draft goes back to the published story. Changes made since the last publish are lost.
editor.leaveDescription: Your changes to this draft haven't been saved.

status.unpublishedChanges: Draft saved. Readers still see the last published version.

chapter.title: Chapter title
chapter.blockNotEditable: This block can't be edited here. It's kept as it is.

scene.heading: Map scene
scene.useCurrentViewHint: Pan and zoom the map, then keep that view for this chapter.
scene.hidden: This chapter's map is unavailable or has been deleted. Its scene is kept unless you remove it.
scene.mapMissing: This scene's map wasn't found. It may have been deleted.

editor.mapHint: Choose a map for a chapter to see it here.
editor.overwriteDescription: Your version replaces the draft. Changes saved elsewhere since you opened it are lost.
editor.reloadDescription: Your unsaved changes here are lost.
editor.mapsMissing_one: {{count}} chapter's scene uses a map that wasn't found. Remove the scene or pick another map, then save.
editor.mapsMissing_other: {{count}} chapters' scenes use maps that weren't found. Remove those scenes or pick other maps, then save.

limits.chapters_one: A story can have up to {{count}} chapter.
limits.chapters_other: A story can have up to {{count}} chapters.
limits.blocks_one: A chapter can have up to {{count}} text block.
limits.blocks_other: A chapter can have up to {{count}} text blocks.
limits.size: This story is larger than the 2 MB a draft can hold. Shorten or remove some text to save it.
limits.altMissing_one: {{count}} image needs alt text before you can save.
limits.altMissing_other: {{count}} images need alt text before you can save.

image.altHint: Describe the image for people who can't see it.
image.caption: Caption (optional)
image.notShown: This image can't be shown. Replace or remove it.

editor.publishedSharingMaps: Story published, and your maps that blocked it are now shared with its groups.

groups.heading: Groups
groups.help: Choose the groups whose members can read this story once it's published. Each scene's map still follows its own access.
groups.effectPrivateEmpty: Pick a group and save to share this story with specific groups.
groups.effectToRestricted: Saving shares this story with specific groups: only you, admins and members of these groups can read it.
groups.effectRestricted: Saving changes which groups can read this story.
groups.effectToPrivate: Saving removes the last group. Only you and admins can read this story.
groups.effectKept: The groups don't change who can read this story now. They apply if you make it private.
groups.savedRestricted: Groups saved. This story is now shared with specific groups only.
groups.savedPrivate: Groups removed. Only you and admins can read this story.
groups.sharedMaps_one: Groups saved, and {{count}} of your maps is now shared with them.
groups.sharedMaps_many: Groups saved, and {{count}} of your maps are now shared with them.
groups.sharedMaps_other: Groups saved, and {{count}} of your maps are now shared with them.
groups.blockedTitle: Some maps can't be read by these groups
groups.blockedCanShare: Some people in these groups can't open the maps below. Share your maps with the groups too, or remove the scenes that use them.
groups.blockedCannotShare: Some people in these groups can't open the maps below, and you can't share all of them. Ask each map's owner to share it with the groups, or remove the scenes that use them.
groups.sharingRevokesLinks: A private map you share this way stops working through its share link and embed codes, and layers the groups can't read stay hidden from them.
